correctness.rationale: This assessment passes the repaired eight-cycle claim. R(hQ) has no poles for h≥0 since its poles lie at 2±i√2 and all eigenvalues of h(P−I) have nonpositive real part. Column sums are one because R(0)=1 and 1ᵀQ=0; cyclic symmetry means the first column suffices. Independently solving for it with a second-order recurrence and two cyclic boundary conditions reproduced signed minima 11824/2058973 at h=2, −5703833/339145563 on the diagonal at h=4, and 127548251905668327/1666416340218976267 at h=20. The repaired table lists full columns; its separately checked integer residuals and invertibility identify them exactly. By continuity, 2 and 20 belong to interiors of different connected components of the positive-step nonnegativity set. This is not disconnectedness caused by the isolated zero step. The frozen mathematics was also correct: coefficient multiplication independently checked the low-size identities, the six-cycle diagonal bound splits at h=3, the exceptional numerator is h⁵p(h) with p′>0 and the exact bracket holds. The fifth Taylor coefficient and Fourier limit justify the two all-size asymptotic assertions. Those statements were removed from the novelty claim for coverage, not falsity.
residual_risks: At least two positive-step components are proved, not a complete eight-cycle classification, a minimum cyclic size for disconnected positive steps, or internal-stage positivity.

originality.rationale: Originality of the frozen headline and items 1–3 fails: multiple distinct Resultary records explicitly state the same method, barrier at six, all-step positivity through size five, exact polynomial and positivity set for six, and larger-cycle small-step failure and ultimate recovery. This is direct coverage, not a suspected overlap or an inference from dates. The PASS applies only to the repaired original item 4: separated positive-step components for the Radau [1/2] endpoint on the uniform one-way eight-cycle. The decisive exact-title/parameter comparisons and focused follow-up distinguish that claim from previously established disconnected Radau windows on undirected stars and from a single bounded positive-step window for Gauss [2/2] on the same directed cycle.
residual_risks: The search was focused and is not evidence against unindexed prior calculations of the subdiagonal one-way cyclic case.
The positive disposition does not extend to originality of the frozen six-state-centered theorem; its direct overlap is preserved in this review.

value.rationale: The surviving exact counterexample answers a specific design question left by the known six-cycle law: does a safe step, once attained above the initial failure, remain safe as the step grows? It refutes that interval assumption within the same family on a small irreducible one-way equal-rate cycle, without taking a different endpoint map or using the degree heterogeneity of a star. The sign separation implies open safe regions with an excluded neighborhood between them, so the useful result is the topology of admissible positive steps, not merely three matrix evaluations.
residual_risks: A witness for this family is not a complete classification of the admissible step regimes, a general positivity criterion, or a minimality theorem.
